legenda: About 19 miles from the Plaza to Wilmington.
narracao: So look at the map again. The city of 1850 sits inland, and the water it used was nineteen miles away, in a bay that wrecked ships, and in a shallow estuary. The problem was never just distance. It was water, and the water would have to be made.
